items.text:
oṁ  bhadraṅ karṇebhiś śṛṇuyāma devāḥ ।
bhadram paśyemā-kṣabhir yajatrāḥ ।
sthiraira-ṅgais tuṣṭuvām̐ sas tanūbhiḥ ।
vyaśema deva hitaṁ yadāyuḥ ॥

translation.en: Oṁ, may we hear with our ears the good fortune of the Devas, may we see with our eyes the good fortune of those worthy of worship, having worshipped by oneself with firm attention (having meditated), we wish to attain the longevity suitable of Devas.

translation.en: Indra of great renown, give us prosperity, All seeing Pūṣan, seer of the world and knowledge, give us prosperity, Imperishable Garuḍa, give us prosperity, Bṛhaspati, guru of the gods, please grant us prosperity!

items.text: oṁ śāntiś śāntiś śāntiḥ ॥

translation.en: Oṁ, peace, peace, peace everywhere and always.

items.text:
oṁ  laṁ  namaste gaṇapataye ।
tvameva pratyakṣan tattvamasi ।
tvameva kevalaṅ kartā'si ।
tvameva kevalan dhartā'si ।
tvameva kevalaṁ hartā'si ।
tvameva sarvaṅ khalvidam brahmā'si ।
tvaṁ sākṣādā-tmā'si nityamˎ॥1॥

translation.en: oṁ laṁ (mūlādhāra cakra bīja) greetings to the group leader, you indeed are visibly real, you indeed are the absolute maker, you indeed are the absolute maintainer, you indeed are the absolute destroyer, you indeed are truly this everything’s universal Soul, you are evidently an everlasting individual soul (ātman).

entries.meaning: the bīja of the mūlādhāra cakra
entries.note: A seed syllable — sound, not a word, and so without grammar.
The enclitic te.

entries.meaning: to the lord of the gaṇas

entries.note: The phrase also sounds the mahāvākya tat tvam asi, "that thou art".

items.text: ṛtaṁ vacmi ।satyaṁ vacmi ॥2॥

translation.en: I am saying sincerely, I am saying truly.

items.text:
ava tvam māmˎ। ava vaktāramˎ। ava śrotāramˎ।
ava dātāramˎ। ava dhātāramˎ। avā-nūcānama-va śiṣyamˎ।
ava paścāt tātˎ। ava puras tātˎ। avo-ttarāt tātˎ।
ava dakṣiṇāt tātˎ। ava co-rdhvāt tātˎ। avā-dharāt tātˎ।
sarvato mām pāhi pāhi samantātˎ॥3॥

translation.en: Please protect me, please protect the speaker, please protect the listener, please protect the benefactor, please protect the organiser, please protect the pupil, protect the disciple, please protect from those behind, please protect from those in front, please protect from those on the left, please protect from those or on the right, please protect also from those above, protect from those below, from all sides please protect me, please protect from every side.

entries.meaning: one who has recited the Veda
entries.note: Perfect participle of anu-√vac.

items.text:
tvaṁ vāṅmayas tvañ cinmayaḥ ।
tvamā-nandamayas tvam brahmamayaḥ ।
tvaṁ saccidānandā-dvitīyo'si ।
tvam pratyakṣam brahmā-si ।
tvam jñānamayo vijñānamayo'si ॥4॥

translation.en: You are eloquent, and you are purely intelligent, you are consisting of pure happiness, you are consisting of the Veda, you are consisting of existence, thought, and joy, you are matchless, you clearly are the Brahman, you are consisting of knowledge, you are consisting of intelligence.

items.text:
sarvañ jagadi-dan tvatto jāyate ।
sarvañ jagadi-dan tvattas tiṣṭhati ।
sarvañ jagadi-dan tvayi layame-ṣyati ।
sarvañ jagadi-dan tvayi pratye-ti ।
tvam bhūmirā-po'nalo'nilo nabhaḥ ।
tvañ catvāri vāk padāni ॥5॥

translation.en: Everything in this Universe is born from You, everything in this Universe exists from You, everything in this Universe will become dissolved in You, everything in this Universe returns in You, you are the earth, water, fire, wind, and the sky, you are the four divisions of speech (parā, pashyanti, madhyamā, vaikhari.)

entries.note: First member of vākpadāni, the four divisions of speech: parā, paśyantī, madhyamā, vaikharī.

items.text:
tvaṅ guṇatrayā-tītaḥ ।
tvam avasthātrayā-tītaḥ ।
tvan dehatrayā-tītaḥ ।
tvaṅ kāla trayā-tītaḥ ।
tvam mūlādhāre sthito'si nityamˎ।
tvaṁ śaktitrayā-tmakaḥ ।
tvāṁ yogino dhyāyanti nityamˎ।
tvam brahmā tvaṁ viṣṇus tvaṁ
rudras tvami-ndras tvama-gnis tvaṁ vāyus tvaṁ sūryas tvañ
candramās tvaṁ brahma bhūrbhuvas svaromˎ॥6॥

translation.en: You are beyond the three guṇas of prakṛti, you are beyond the three states of consciousness, you are beyond the concept of the three bodies (kāraṇa, sūkṣma, and sthūla śarīra), you are beyond the concept of the three times (past, present, and future,) you are always being situated in mūlādhāra cakra, you are the embodiment of three powers (of will, knowledge, and action,) devotees always meditate unto you. You are Brahmā, you are Viṣṇu, you are Rudra, you are Indra you are Agni, you are Vāyu, you are Sūrya, you are the Moon, you are the Absolute, the ground, atmosphere, and the heavenly region, oṁ.

avasthā-traya-atīta — waking, dream and deep sleep.
deha-traya-atīta — kāraṇa, sūkṣma and sthūla śarīra.

entries.meaning: having the three powers as your nature

items.text:
gaṇā-dim pūrvamu-ccārya varṇā-din tadanantaramˎ।
anusvāraḥ parataraḥ । ardhendu lasitamˎ।
tāreṇa ṛddhamˎ। etat tava manu svarūpamˎ।
gakāraḥ pūrva rūpamˎ। akāro madhyama rūpamˎ।
anusvāraś cā-ntya rūpamˎ। binduru-ttara rūpamˎ।
nādas sandhānamˎ। sam̐hitā sandhiḥ । saiṣā gāṇeśavidyā ।
gaṇaka ṛṣiḥ । nicṛdgāyatrī chandaḥ ।
śrī mahāgaṇapatir devatā ।
oṁ  gaṁ  gaṇapataye namaḥ ॥7॥

translation.en: The first to be pronounced is the beginning of “gaṇa” (g), then the beginning of the alphabet (+a), the nasal sound anusvāra (+ṁ) at the very end, arisen is the half - Moon It is made to resound with a mystical monosyllable (oṁ), this is Your incantation embodiment. First is the form of the letter ga, in the middle the form of the letter a, and in the last place is the form of anusvāra, above is the form of a dot united with the transcendental subtle sound, oṁ, joined together according to euphonic rules, this is the very knowledge of Gāṇeśa. Ṛṣi is Gaṇaka, metre is nicṛdgāyatrī, the divine Mahāgaṇapati is the divinity, oṁ gam - adoration to Gaṇapati.

varṇādim — the first letter of the alphabet, i.e. a.

ekadantāya vidmahe vakratuṇḍāya dhīmahi ।
tan no dantī pracodayātˎ॥8॥

translation.en: To the single tusk that we know, and to the curved trunk may we meditate, may that tusked one inspire us.

entries.note: The enclitic naḥ.

items.text:
ekadantañ caturhastam pāśama-ṅkuśa dhāriṇamˎ।
radañ ca varadaṁ hastair bibhrāṇam mūṣaka dhvajamˎ।
raktaṁ lambo-daraṁ śūrpa karṇakaṁ rakta vāsasamˎ।
rakta gandhā-nuliptā-ṅgaṁ rakta puṣpais supūjitamˎ।
bhaktā-nukampinan devañ jagat kāraṇama-cyutamˎ।
āvirbhūtañ ca sṛṣṭyā-dau prakṛteḥ puruṣāt paramˎ।
evan dhyāyati yo nityaṁ sa yogī yogināṁ varaḥ ॥9॥

translation.en: One tusked, four handed, bearing a noose and a hook, with hands bearing an elephant tusk, a benefactor mudra, and a mouse as His divine attribute, his hanging belly and baby elephant’s ears are red, and red are the garments, limbs are anointed with sweet fragrance and red flowers, highly honoured, merciful Lord of a devotee, infallible cause of creation of the universe, evidently the Creation and Him both came to be in the beginning from the origin of Supreme Puruṣa, thus he who meditates constantly, he is the choicest devotee of the devotees.

items.text:
namo vrātapataye । namo gaṇapataye ।
namaḥ pramathapataye ।
namaste'stu lambo-darāyai-kadantāya vighnavināśine
śivasutāya śrī varadamūrtaye namo namaḥ ॥10॥

translation.en: Adoration to the lord of the groups of people, adoration to the lord of the groups of gods, adoration to the lord of the groups of violent Shiva's hosts. Greetings to you, to the one with a hanging belly and a single tusk, the obstacle remover, the son Śiva, to the divine embodiment of boon giving. Adoration! Adoration!

entries.meaning: to the lord of the hosts
to the lord of the gaṇas
to the lord of the pramathas
entries.note: The pramathas are Śiva’s attendants.

items.text:
etada-tharvaśīrṣaṁ yo'dhīte ।
sa brahma bhūyāya kalpate ।
sa sarva vighnair na bādhyate ।
sa sarvatra sukhame-dhate ।
sa pañca mahāpāpāt pramucyate ।
sāyama-dhīyāno divasa kṛtam pāpan nāśayati ।
prātara-dhīyāno rātri kṛtam pāpan nāśayati ।
sāyam prātaḥ prayuñjāno pāpo'pāpo bhavati ।
sarvatrā-dhīyāno'pavighno bhavati ।
dharmā-rtha kāma mokṣañ ca vindati ।
idama-tharvaśīrṣama-śiṣyāya na deyamˎ।
yo yadi mohād dāsyati sa pāpīyān bhavati ।
sahasrā-vartanād yaṁ yaṅ kāmama-dhīte
tan tama-nena sādhayetˎ॥11॥

translation.en: One who learns this fore-part of Atharva Veda, he is fit to become the Absolute, he will not be suffering from any obstacles, his happiness increases always and from all sides, he is released from five great sins (brāhmaṇahatya, surāpāna, suvarṇasteya, gurutalpaga, saṁsarga,) regular studying in the evening causes sins done during the day to disappear, regular studying at dawn causes sins done during the night to disappear, turning the mind to it in the evening and at dawn, the sinner becomes free from all sins, by regular study he becomes unobstructed always and everywhere, he obtains righteousness, wealth, desire, and liberation, this Atharvaśīrṣa should not be given to the non-disciple, if one will instructs it by mistake, he becomes the most sinful, by reading a thousand repetitions, whatever desire one has, that may cause it to be fulfilled.

entries.note: Second member of brahmabhūyāya, "for becoming the Absolute".

anena gaṇapatima-bhiṣiñcati sa vāgmī bhavati ।
caturthyāma-naśnan japati sa vidyāvān bhavati ।
itya-tharvaṇa vākyamˎ।
brahmā-dyā-varaṇaṁ vidyān na bibheti kadācane-ti ॥12॥

translation.en: By consecrating this Gaṇapati with water, one becomes eloquent, fasting on caturthī, he who prays becomes learned, so say the descendants of Atharvan, one should know a shield of the first son of Brahmā to become fearless at any time.

entries.note: Negated present participle of √aś — i.e. fasting.

yo dūrvā-ṅkurair yajati sa vaiśravaṇo-pamo bhavati ।
yo lājair yajati sa yaśovān bhavati । sa medhāvān bhavati ।
yo modaka sahasreṇa yajati sa vāñchita phalama-vāpnoti ।
yas sājya samidbhir yajati
sa sarvaṁ labhate sa sarvaṁ labhate ॥13॥

translation.en: One who worships with newly grown grass sacrifice, becomes rich like a descendant of Kubera, one who worships with grains sacrifice becomes famous, he becomes wise, one who worships with a thousand modaka sweets sacrifice obtains what he desires as a reward, one who worships using clarified butter and a bundle of firewood sticks sacrifice, he obtains everything, he obtains everything

entries.note: dūrvā-aṅkura — the sacred bent grass.
vaiśravaṇa-upama — Kubera, the lord of wealth.

aṣṭau brāhmaṇān samyag grāhayitvā sūrya varcasvī bhavati ।
sūrya grahe mahānadyām pratimā sannidhau
vā japtvā siddhamantro bhavati ।
mahāvighnāt pramucyate ।
mahādoṣāt pramucyate ।
mahāpāpāt pramucyate ।
mahāpratyavāyāt pramucyate ।
sa sarvavid bhavati sa sarvavid bhavati ।
ya evaṁ veda । (ityu-paniṣatˎ) ॥14॥

translation.en: Who provides eight brāhmaṇas to learn it, becomes vigorous as Sūrya. Observing the reflection of a solar eclipse from the shore of a great river, while also whispering this perfect mantra, one becomes: - free from the great obstacle, - free from the great disease, - free from the great sin, - free from the great detriment, - he becomes omniscient, he becomes omniscient. For he who knows so, (what is said is confidential.)

entries.note: Second member of sūryavarcasvī, "lustrous as the sun".
Second member of sūryagrahe, "at a solar eclipse".
